defs.def: having the colour of grass or the leaves of most plants and trees 绿色的；草绿色的

ex.s: The greening of planes, trains and automobiles
ex.t: "我觉得这是个很棒的主意，"塔尼亚·佩里利说，她经营着一家服装租赁店。

ex.s: By the end of the century，if not sooner，the world's oceans will be bluer and greener thanks to a warming climate，according to a new study.
ex.t: 到本世纪末，如果不是早一点，世界的海洋将会因为气候变暖而变得更加蓝绿，根据一项新的研究。

ex.s: As a photographer I love the bright light and amazing colours: red rocks, green plants blue-green waters and blue skies.
ex.t: 作为一名摄影师，我喜爱明亮的光线和惊人的色彩：红色的岩石、绿色的植物、蓝绿色的水和蓝天。

ex.s: The landscape that lines the route is beautiful and dramatic, with snowy mountains and green valleys.
ex.t: 沿途的风景美丽而壮观，有雪山和翠绿的山谷。

ex.s: The fuels for transport need to be not just green, cheap and powerful, but also lightweight and safe enough to be carried around.
ex.t: 交通燃料不仅需要环保、廉价和强劲，还需要轻便、足够安全以便携带。

ex.s: I climbed and climbed． There was nothing but just green bushes and these steps． I had to reach the top!
ex.t: 我爬呀爬。除了绿色的灌木和这些台阶，什么都没有。我必须到达山顶！

ex.s: Much is still to be settled, but here are some of the solutions to get us going green.
ex.t: 还有很多问题有待解决，但以下是一些帮助我们走向绿色的解决方案。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术，以帮助公共交通走向绿色，同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

ex.s: It was so peaceful and quiet and the colors of the brown rocks, the deep green pine trees, and the late afternoon sun mixed to create a magic scene.
ex.t: 一切如此宁静安详，棕岩、深绿松树和傍晚夕阳的色彩交融，构成一幅神奇的画面。

defs.def: covered with grass or other plants 长满青草的；绿油油的；青葱的

ex.s: Which is Mr Green's favorite movie?
ex.t: 格林先生最喜欢的电影是哪部？

ex.s: Among the writers of the plays in this collection, Paul Green, Susan Glaspell, Maxwell Anderson, Thornton Wilder, William Saroyan, and Tennessee Williams have all received Pulitzer Prizes for their contributions to the theater.
ex.t: 在本剧本集的作家中，保罗·格林、苏珊·格拉斯佩尔、麦克斯韦尔·安德森、桑顿·怀尔德、威廉·萨罗扬和田纳西·威廉姆斯都因其对戏剧的贡献而获得普利策奖。

ex.s: At 9:30am, the full red/yellow/green signal cycle might be 140 seconds.
ex.t: 早上9:30，完整的红/黄/绿信号周期可能是140秒。

defs.def: not yet ready to eat 未成熟的

ex.s: But in some waters，such as those of the Arctic，a warming will make conditions riper for phytoplankton，and these areas will turn greener.
ex.t: 但在某些水域，如北极海域，变暖将使浮游植物的生长条件更加成熟，这些区域将变得更绿。

defs.def: concerned with the protection of the environment; supporting the protection of the environment as a political principle 环境保护的；赞成环保的

ex.s: While cars and trains are moving towards greener, electric power, emissions from air travel are expected to increase massively by 2050.
ex.t: 虽然汽车和火车正朝着更环保、电动化的方向发展，但预计到2050年，航空旅行的排放量将大幅增加。

ex.s: He says it’s not easy to convince people that nutria fur is green, but he has no doubt about it.
ex.t: 他说，让人相信海狸鼠毛皮是环保的不容易，但他对此毫不怀疑。

ex.s: to meet the requirement of green economy
ex.t: 让人们想起一个历史时期

defs.def: being a pale colour, as if the person is going to vomit 人或其皮肤
the colour of grass and the leaves of most plants and trees 绿色；草绿色

ex.s: In summer, rice is growing on these mountains, which makes them turn bright green.
ex.t: 夏季，大米生长在这些山上，这使得它们变成明亮的绿色。

ex.s: Ocean colour varies from green to blue，depending on the type and concentration of phytoplankton.
ex.t: 海水的颜色因浮游植物的种类和浓度不同，而从绿色到蓝色变化。

ex.s: In line with longstanding initiatives to expand its green spaces, New York City is planting tens of thousands of trees each year.
ex.t: 为配合长期以来扩大绿色空间的举措，纽约市每年种植数万棵树木。

ex.s: “The ability to design, build and export green technologies for producing clean water, clean air and healthy and abundant food is going to be the currency of power in the new century.”
ex.t: “设计、制造并向其他国家出口用于生产清洁水、清洁空气以及健康丰足食物的绿色技术的能力，将成为新世纪里实力的象征。”

ex.s: Summer sees the mountains turn bright green with growing rice.
ex.t: 夏季，这些山随着水稻的生长变成明亮的绿色。

ex.s: To promote green transportation.
ex.t: 为了推广绿色交通。

ex.s: “We need to speed up the development of green energy, and it will all get used,” says Wipke.
ex.t: Wipke说：“我们需要加快绿色能源的发展，而它都会被用上。”

ex.s: Which mode of transport can go green comparatively easily?
ex.t: 哪种交通方式相对更容易实现绿色转型？

ex.s: Benefits from green plants.
ex.t: 来自绿色植物的益处。

ex.s: If we want big green sky solutions, we need blue sky thinking.
ex.t: 如果我们想要大型绿色天空解决方案，我们需要富有远见的创新思维。

ex.s: These gardens have helped make the cities greener and improve air quality.
ex.t: 这些花园帮助城市变得更加绿色，改善了空气质量。

defs.def: green vegetables 绿色蔬菜；绿叶蔬菜

ex.s: The innovative design requires little effort to achieve a reliable weekly supply of fresh greens.
ex.t: 这一创新设计只需很少的投入，就能实现稳定的每周新鲜蔬菜供应。

ex.s: Catherine Murphy, a cafe worker in a green shirt and black hat, makes sure that each customer gets exactly what they order.
ex.t: Catherine Murphy是一名穿着绿衬衫、戴黑帽子的咖啡馆员工，她确保每位顾客都得到自己点的东西。

ex.s: Paragraph 1:  When Mr and Mrs Green got home, Kevin went to talk to them.
ex.t: 第1段：当格林夫妇回到家时，凯文去和他们说话。

ex.s: Paragraph 2:  Kevin and Mr Green took the watch they had found to the police station.
ex.t: 第2段：凯文和格林先生把他们捡到的手表交到了警察局。

ex.s: What is the first question to Mr Green about?
ex.t: 向格林先生提的第一个问题是什么？

ex.s: How does Mr Green feel about traveling to Mars?
ex.t: 格林先生对去火星旅行有什么感受？

ex.s: What is Jennifer Green doing?
ex.t: Professor Bastian的书是关于什么的？

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市Factoria大道上的交通信号，通常连续两次不会亮同样时长的绿灯，尤其在高峰时段。

ex.s: Increased length of green lights.
ex.t: 绿灯时间延长。

ex.s: I   56   twelve shades of green from where I stand.
ex.t: 从我的立场上看，我只有56个12个绿荫

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点踩到一段楼梯。这些台阶通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，尽管我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始爬上那些神秘莫测的台阶。

defs.def: an area of grass, especially in the middle of a town or village （尤指城镇或村庄中心的）草地，草坪，公共绿地

ex.s: Jaramillo’s students live in neighborhoods where fresh food and green space are not easy to find and fast food restaurants outnumber grocery stores.
ex.t: 哈拉米略的学生居住的社区里，新鲜食物和绿地很难找到，快餐店的数量超过了杂货店。

ex.s: Then one perfect Amazonian evening, with monkeys calling from beyond the village green, we played soccer.
ex.t: 后来在一个完美的亚马孙夜晚，村庄绿地那头猴子鸣叫，我们踢起了足球。

defs.def: an area of grass cut short around a hole on a golf course 高尔夫球

ex.s: Mrs Hill’s front window faced Mr and Mrs Green’s house across the street.
ex.t: 希尔太太家的前窗正对着街对面格林夫妇的房子。

defs.def: the Green Party (= the party whose main aim is the protection of the environment) 绿党（以保护环境为主要目标）
to create parks and other areas with trees and plants in a city 绿化

ex.s: A study conducted in Youngstown，Ohio，for example, discovered that greener areas of the city experienced less crime.
ex.t: 例如，在俄亥俄州扬斯敦进行的一项研究发现，城市里绿化更好的区域犯罪更少。

defs.def: to make sb more aware of issues connected with the environment; to make sth appear friendly towards the environment 使增强环境保护意识；使善待环境

ex.s: Oceans with more phytoplankton may appear greener.
ex.t: 浮游植物在海洋生态系统中的作用在下降。
